notes.title: Global Update!
notes.notes:
The main goal of the update is to make the gameplay more comfortable, to add story immersion, interesting quests and an even creepier atmosphere to the game.

Story
Now the character begins the game with a prologue. He wakes up in the basement, and immerses himself in the backstory by reading notes and listening to audio diaries on tapes. To get to the main building, you need to go through quests in the basement, which require logical thinking and ingenuity. An omnibus storyline is also introduced, according to which the character has to investigate the circumstances of the disappearance of the detectives who investigated this place before him.

Graphics update
Updated textures of rooms, added details of locations. The layout of the premises has been partially changed on the map. There were more of them, as well as possible shelters and opportunities to bypass.
Added new post-processing effects: fog from dust (with quality behavior relative to light).
The lighting has also been changed. Places where there are no light sources are completely dark, but at maximum zoom, the surrounding elements and the character's hands are still visible.
The light sources now have an increased quality of distribution, and the translucence of surfaces has been eliminated.

Game mechanics
Improved mechanics of previous quests, more carefully implemented mechanics of boss behavior.

Bug fixes and refinement

Changed footsteps sounds


Changed footsteps sounds


Changed footsteps sounds


Redesigned interface


Replaced boss models


Improved the quality of the map, the character does not get stuck in certain places, doors do not crash into the elements of the environment, etc


Revised balance of character speed and bosses


Reworked animations of the character, bosses, screamers.


This update is not the end! Over time, the plot of the game and its mechanics will be supplemented. Follow the game and offer your ideas in the blogs.

notes.title: Graphics update
notes.notes:
We've updated the graphics and level of detail of Escape from School F.E.L.I.K. Many new scenery elements have been added, room interiors have been redesigned, and new visual effects have been added. The lighting has also undergone changes. The light sources on the map have become much larger, but poorly lit areas have become darker. These changes helped to achieve a more realistic and scary atmosphere in the game.

Post-processing changes

Added new vignetting effects. Light compressors have been changed. Different locations now have different post-processing effects applied for better compliance.
Changed the smoothing type from HDR to MMSI, added screen motion blur. Eliminated image breaks during sharp turns.

New gameplay features


Markers are added to the lockers so that they are visible in poorly lit places.


The character's walking speed has been reduced from 600 units/sec to 550 units/sec.


Acceleration rate has been reduced from 800 units/sec to 650 units/sec.


Acceleration time has been increased from 4 seconds to 7 seconds.


Haste cooldown increased from 5 seconds to 8 seconds.


Added new types of screamers and their spawn locations.


The camera pan in the cut-scene of Felik's finishing has been corrected. The rotation of the camera to the mob is fixed. (In some cases, the camera made several turns)


Added a new mutant model used in screamers and quests.

Added hints in the form of markers for quest items:

Table in the Ritual Room


Control center 305 (place where cassettes are inserted)


Computer in the ritual room (with a full explanation of the quest and action plan).


Hints about the gameplay have been added, in particular, a table with a warning about the desired presence of a camera has been placed in building 2.



Bug Fixes

Reworked camera mechanics. Earlier there were bugs when the light did not hit Ilyich. Now the flash can pass through minor obstacles in front of the target. The flash damage range was increased.


Fixed a bug when Illich came close to the character, but did not attack.


Fixed a bug when in the Ritual Room the cvxt did not start due to the fact that the player does not have a camera. At the same time, the room was closing and he could not get out. The only solution was to exit the game.


Fixed the possibility of multiple activation of the computer in the Ritual Room. Now, after the message appears, it will be impossible to reactivate the computer. This error made it possible to collect several cassettes.


In the statue knocking quest, problems with movement inside the room have been fixed. Previously, the character rested against the invisible walls, which were the disappearing shelves.


Fixed a bug with the disappearance of some location decorations after death. For the sake of optimization, objects in buildings where there is no character are hidden on the map. In some cases, due to a faulty trigger system, the level could not load, and some objects were in the air.


Fixed a bug when Illich could not go down to the 1st floor of building 2. Also, unexpected teleports to the place of his appearance were associated with this. Eliminated cases when he got stuck in obstacles. Fixed sound bugs.


Updated locations

All places on the map have become more detailed due to graffiti on the walls, garbage on the floors. Also, in some areas, damage to the walls was added, and there was more dynamic furniture. Some places on the map have different wall textures, wallpapers, and interior design. The lighting effects have been enhanced, the map has become brighter, but the eerie atmosphere remains.

About the update
The main goal of this update is to bring the game to a good, competitive level. We updated the old quests, added more elaborate methods of screamers and adjusted their number. If you notice any errors in the gameplay, you can send them to the contact e-mail address so that they can be corrected as soon as possible.

notes.title: Release Update 1.2.0
notes.notes: In this update, we made the gameplay much more convenient, fixing many minor bugs, sounds, mechanics.
